A_prologue.centre: 1:12 (syllable centre of the prologue): the pipes open to the fourth and fifth above the mese

Solomon's side chambers (1 Kgs 6:6): 5,.chord: frequencies 1/5 : 1/6 : 1/7 = 42 : 35 : 30, a minor third (6:5) over a septimal minor third (7:6): a narrow, dark, diminished-type chord

The centre bar (Exod 26:28): one bar thr.note: along-grain sound speed of hardwood 3,500-5,000 m/s: the bar's lowest ring spans 131-187 Hz, the range of the ark zither

Ten lampstands (1 Kgs 7:49).mapping: the menorah multiplied: 5 on the right, 5 on the left = ten seven-pipe ranks, 70 pipes

Seven lamps with seven pipes (Zech 4:2).mapping: the text itself names 'pipes' (Hebrew mutsaqot, conduits) on a seven-lamp golden stand

Harps on alamoth, lyres on the sheminith.reading: widely read as registers: alamoth = high ('maidens'), sheminith = 'the eighth', an octave (K: meaning uncertain)
Harps on alamoth, lyres on the sheminith.mapping: the ark zither doubled: one rank high, one an octave below

Almug-wood lyres and harps (1 Kgs 10:12).note: the only explicit instruction to build instruments for the House

Herod's temple (Mishnah Middot 4:6).note: the temple Jesus taught in was itself a cube; its Holy of Holies 20 x 20 (Middot 4:7); 15 steps where the Levites sang (Middot 2:5)

The New Jerusalem (Rev 21:16-17).city: a cube, 12,000 stadia each way (about 2,220 km)
The New Jerusalem (Rev 21:16-17).note: the final Holy of Holies is a cube: the same shape as the tabernacle's and Solomon's inner rooms and Herod's house
